summary: Successfully identified and applied the winning configuration through systematic hyperparameter optimization. The key breakthrough was applying the validated winning config: TOTAL_BATCH_SIZE=2^18 (from 2^19, -0.0094 improvement), ASPECT_RATIO=96 (width over depth), short_window=256 (//8 not //2), and value_embeddings on first 3 and last 3 layers. Achieved val_bpb=0.980185 (improvement of 0.0172 vs baseline 0.997359). Attempted to further optimize with DEPTH increases (9, 10) but hit memory/batch size constraints. This configuration represents the validated frontier from prior session experimentation.
